thesis: With the shared Alpaca book holding 100% cash ($1,000 equity) and zero positions, Agent A3 proposes establishing a core broad-market ballast allocation via a $50.00 buy of VTI (5% of equity) in line with our balanced mandate to mix equities and ballast. The 15:00 ET news pack reflects ongoing macro cross-currents, including MarketWatch reports that Wall Street's rally is showing cracks under the strain of elevated oil prices, rising Treasury yields, and Fed rate-hike expectations, alongside narrow US-China tariff cuts ($60B on dolls and fireworks) that leave key tech and strategic issues unresolved. Single-name items (MongoDB's CEO departure to Meta, Micron earnings positioning, Nvidia valuation commentary) do not warrant concentrated single-stock risk. Initiating a conservative $50 starter position in total market ETF VTI establishes foundational diversification while leaving $950 in cash (95% of equity), comfortably exceeding the 15% cash floor and preserving strong liquidity against macroeconomic volatility.
